product.name: Digital Appointment Booking System
product.description: A mobile app feature that allows users to book medical and wellness appointments at various clinics and centers.

product.name: Medical and Wellness Service Listings
product.description: A catalog of medical and wellness services including dermatology, dentistry, laser treatments, and aesthetic procedures offered by partner clinics.

product.name: Online Payment Processing
product.description: A payment processing feature integrated into the mobile app for secure transactions related to booking and purchasing medical and wellness services.

product.name: User Account Management
product.description: A system for users to create, manage, and access their accounts, including password recovery and profile updates within the mobile app.

product.name: Home Spa and Massage Services
product.description: A service offering various spa and massage treatments delivered at home, including bamboo massage, pregnancy massage, and therapeutic massages.
